correctness.rationale: Transition probabilities are correctly normalized by F_A=r(l-k+1)+k and F_B=k+1+r(l-k), with null steps retained. Deleting holding yields an r-independent jump chain; S(h,k)=h+l k is a bounded martingale, so its absorbing value gives h(A0)=1/(l^2+1). Conditional occupancy is Doob h-transform of the transient fundamental matrix and geometric holding times sum to A_l r+B_l+C_l/r. Because C_l-A_l=l/(l+1)(l H_{l-1}-(l-1))>0, the derivative vanishes uniquely at r>1 and second derivative 2C_l/r^3>0. I independently built the complete labeled-state rational transition matrix and solved absorption and first-moment systems for l=2,3,4 at r=1/2,1,3/2,2, all 12 cases exactly agreeing with the all-parameter formulas.
